metadata.title: High-Contrast Gritty Portrait with Aggressive Lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark black-and-white composition featuring a shirtless male figure in profile against a pure black background, overlaid with large, aggressive, textured custom lettering that interacts with the subject's form.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic hair movement vs. sharp geometric lettering
Grainy photographic texture vs. flat graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally but slightly offset, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, horizontally stretched title text spanning the middle third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the horizontal stretch of the text from left to right, then moves upward to the subject's hair and down the profile of the body.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space at the top and sides creates a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for total isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mid-tone greys in the subject's skin and hair to provide form.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright, textured silver-grey for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white text and black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended, aggressive sans-serif with sharp, blade-like terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Sharp, jagged edges resembling torn paper or metal
Integrated 'drips' or splatters extending from the strokes
Variable stroke width with heavy emphasis on horizontal bars
characterSpecificRedesigns: Internal counters are minimized or sharp-angled

composition.overlap: partially obscures the subject's neck and chest

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller handwritten or script-style tag placed below the main title for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, raw energy of the original design.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a shirtless man in profile against a solid black background. The lighting should be harsh, highlighting the contours of the muscles and the texture of the hair which should be styled in dreadlocks or twists pointing backwards.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, horizontally-stretched custom title across the center. The letters should have a jagged, blade-like appearance with a grainy silver texture. Add a smaller, handwritten-style tag in the bottom right corner of the main text.

verificationChecks: Is the text horizontally stretched and jagged?
Does the text overlap the subject's torso?

adjustableVariables: Degree of horizontal stretch in the text
Amount of text overlap on the subject
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact letter shapes of the original logo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present.
Verify the text texture matches the gritty feel of the photo.
Check that the subject's silhouette is sharp against the black.
Confirm the typography feels integrated rather than just pasted on.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome photography + horizontally stretched aggressive custom lettering + grainy texture overlay.
